observations.rainfall_temp: Dry, cool to cold nights. Temperatures range from 4°C to 25°C. No significant rainfall.
observations.water_wetlands: Seasonal wetlands like Chari-Dhand host migratory birds; water scarcity in interior parts.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Cultivation of winter crops (Rabi) like cumin, mustard; pastoralism (Maldharis) relies on dry fodder.
observations.wildlife_activity: High migratory bird activity in Banni grasslands and Rann. Wild Ass mating season concludes.

observations.rainfall_temp: Extremely hot and dry. Temperatures regularly exceed 40°C. Arid winds.
observations.water_wetlands: Severe water stress; wetlands dry up completely leaving salt crusts in the Rann.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Minimal agriculture; reliance on drought-resistant livestock breeds. Migration of pastoralists towards wetter regions.
observations.wildlife_activity: Wildlife concentrates around artificial waterholes. Heat stress for native fauna.

observations.rainfall_temp: Erratic and low rainfall (300-400mm). Humid conditions, temperatures 25-35°C.
observations.water_wetlands: Inundation of the Great and Little Rann; ephemeral rivers flow briefly.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Kharif sowing dependent on rain (bajra, pulses); resurgence of grass in Banni for grazing.
observations.wildlife_activity: Breeding season for flamingos in the Rann; amphibian and insect explosion.

observations.rainfall_temp: Mild and pleasant. Temperatures 15-30°C. Low humidity.
observations.water_wetlands: Coastal estuaries and mangroves provide stable marine habitats. Inland reservoirs hold post-monsoon water.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Thriving Rabi season (wheat, groundnut). Fishing season at its peak along the coast.
observations.wildlife_activity: Whale sharks arrive in the coastal waters of Sutrapada/Veraval. Migratory waterfowl in coastal wetlands.

observations.rainfall_temp: Hot and humid. Temperatures 25-38°C. Sea breeze moderates coastal temperatures.
observations.water_wetlands: Reduction in freshwater inflow to estuaries; increased salinity in coastal groundwater.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Fishing continues but faces heat challenges. Pre-monsoon agricultural preparations.
observations.wildlife_activity: Nesting of sea turtles on sandy beaches. Marine life moves to deeper, cooler waters.

data_integrity.limitations: Localized sea surface temp data needed

observations.rainfall_temp: Heavy, cyclonic rainfall possible (600-1000mm). High winds and humidity.
observations.water_wetlands: Rivers like Bhadar flood; coastal erosion and mangrove inundation.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Fishing ban in effect due to rough seas. Kharif crop (cotton, groundnut) sowing.
observations.wildlife_activity: Fish breeding season in estuaries; dispersal of coastal bird populations.

observations.water_wetlands: Perennial rivers (Tapi, Narmada, Dangs region streams) flow steadily; rich forest moisture.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Sugarcane and horticulture (mango orchards) thrive. Forest produce collection by tribal communities.
observations.wildlife_activity: Leopards and sloth bears highly active. Rich avian diversity in Dangs and Vansda.

observations.rainfall_temp: Warm to hot. Temperatures 25-40°C. Leaf fall in deciduous forests.
observations.water_wetlands: Minor streams dry up; major rivers rely on dam releases. Reduced forest humidity.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Mango harvesting peaks. Water-intensive sugarcane faces stress in non-canal areas.
observations.wildlife_activity: Wildlife relies on specific perennial forest pools. Increased human-wildlife conflict for water.

observations.rainfall_temp: Heavy to very heavy rainfall (1500-2500mm+). High humidity, lush green cover.
observations.water_wetlands: Rivers in spate; widespread flooding in plains. Abundant freshwater habitats.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Paddy cultivation. Difficulty in forest access for non-timber produce gathering.
observations.wildlife_activity: Breeding season for reptiles and amphibians; dense foliage provides high cover for predators.

observations.rainfall_temp: Cold, especially at night (8-25°C). Dry continental air from Rajasthan.
observations.water_wetlands: Lakes and reservoirs hold water; rivers like Sabarmati sustain managed flows.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Extensive Rabi cultivation (wheat, castor, mustard) using canal/ground water. Dairy cooperatives active.
observations.wildlife_activity: Sloth bears in Jessore sanctuary active; migratory birds in Thol lake.

observations.rainfall_temp: Scorching heat. Temperatures frequently cross 42°C. Loo winds.
observations.water_wetlands: Severe evaporation; many village ponds dry up. High reliance on deep borewells.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Summer crops limited to irrigated areas. Dairy faces heat stress challenges.
observations.wildlife_activity: Reduced diurnal activity; mammals seek shade in thorny scrublands.

observations.water_wetlands: Recharge of groundwater and surface water bodies. Sabarmati and Banas rivers swell.
observations.agriculture_livelihoods: Major Kharif sowing (cotton, castor). Pastures rejuvenate supporting dairy.
observations.wildlife_activity: Aravalli foothills turn green supporting herbivores; bird nesting in scrub forests.
